manualReview.summary: Selected author diet DE genes compared against current registered output
manualReview.note: The official VST matrix and SOFT match the SHA-256 values documented in the dataset README. GEO now links PMID 42239780 (Le et al. 2026, Research Square rs-9695368 v1, PMC13228855). The official preprint supplement XLSX (SHA-256 8a987444ab1c7523afa8731d1a7d02df1b3eb318318496f6302d6030c617f48b) Supp Table 7 'Full Dataset' block lists 101 VMH genes DE by diet with sex as covariate (DESeq2 ~ W1+W2+W3+seqbatch+Sex+Diet+Sex_Diet, RUVg factors, Wald test, ashr-shrunken LFC, BH FDR<0.1). The methods also state the model as ~ Sex + Diet + Sequencing Batch and describe Sex_Diet as a factorized interaction term, so whether the Full-block Diet coefficient is the additive sex-adjusted effect registered locally is not confirmed. Orientation high-fat minus low-fat is inferred, not labelled: Table 7 has no orientation label, and the inference rests on the ECM pathway (Supp Table 8 GSEA) text and positive collagen LFCs; the 96/97 sign agreement is consistent with it. 2026-11-15 scoped comparison against the unchanged registered limma-on-VST output (sex covariate, HIGH.FAT minus LOW.FAT): 97/101 author genes pair by exact symbol (LOC100910088, Ccn3, LOC102555037 and Ifitm2 unjoined; none resolved arbitrarily); nonzero direction agreement 96/97 (Rgs9 reversed); Pearson 0.323, Spearman 0.322, OLS slope 0.168 (local on author) within the range-restricted significant-only list; median absolute LFC 0.0624 author versus 0.0627 local. Author ashr-shrunken DESeq2 count-model LFC and the unshrunk limma coefficient on VST are both log2 scale but not the same estimator. Local padj<0.1 for 1 of 97 author FDR genes and 1 gene in the full 20,211-gene published universe; 53/97 have local raw P<0.05. Female- and male-stratified blocks are not the registered contrast. Selected-gene evidence only; it does not establish full-universe or inferential agreement. The PMC full-text XML (sole source for the model, orientation and 101-gene statement) is retained with the evidence in continued-sources/GSE330152/turbo-2026-11-15-notloc3/.
reviewFlags: Selected 101-gene FDR<0.1 reference only; the author nonsignificant tail is not available.
Author DESeq2 with RUVg W1-W3, seqbatch and ashr shrinkage versus registered limma on VST with sex only; 101 versus 1 FDR<0.1 calls.
Author model includes a Sex_Diet term and the methods state two different models; the Full-block Diet estimand is not confirmed as the registered additive sex-adjusted effect.

evidenceLinks.label: Preprint supplement, Supp Table 7 Full Dataset block

verificationReview.reason: 2026-11-15: GEO now links PMID 42239780 (PMC13228855). Preprint Supp Table 7 Full Dataset block: 101 selected FDR<0.1 diet genes; 97 paired by exact symbol (coverage 0.9604); nonzero direction agreement 96/97 (0.9897); Pearson 0.323, Spearman 0.322, OLS slope 0.168. Author DESeq2 with RUVg factors, seqbatch, a Sex_Diet term and ashr shrinkage reports 101 FDR<0.1 genes versus 1 in the registered limma-on-VST output; the methods state two different models, so the Diet estimand is not confirmed. Selected author effects mostly agree in direction (96/97); contrast estimand, effect definition, inference and coverage remain qualified. Evidence is in continued-sources/GSE330152/turbo-2026-11-15-notloc3/.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the complete author DESeq2 diet result (all tested genes) or analysis code with the RUVg control-gene set and the Sex_Diet coding, to confirm the Diet estimand and orientation; reproduce the author model separately if inferential verification is needed. Keep the four unjoined author genes and the 101-versus-1 FDR call difference explicit.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered limma on the deposited VST matrix, sex covariate, high-fat minus low-fat VMH.
comparabilityReview.reference: Research Square rs-9695368 v1 supplement Supp Table 7, Full Dataset block: 101 DESeq2 FDR<0.1 diet genes with ashr-shrunken LFC.

cohort.note: Same GEO VMH cohort with both sexes and both diets; author DE sample count (about 400 sequenced) versus 391 deposited VST columns is not reconciled.

contrast.note: Both oriented high-fat minus low-fat (author orientation inferred from ECM pathway text and collagen LFC signs). Author methods give the DE model as ~ W1+W2+W3+seqbatch+Sex+Diet+Sex_Diet (factorized interaction term) and also as ~ Sex + Diet + Sequencing Batch; whether the Full-block Diet coefficient is the additive sex-adjusted effect registered locally is not established.

features.note: 97/101 author symbols join exactly; 4 unjoined, none resolved arbitrarily.

effects.note: Author ashr-shrunken DESeq2 count-model LFC versus unshrunk limma coefficient on the deposited VST; both log2 scale but not the same estimator. Numerically 96/97 nonzero directions agree, Pearson 0.323, OLS slope 0.168 within the significant-only list.

inference.note: Author DESeq2 with RUVg W1-W3 and seqbatch reports 101 FDR<0.1 genes; registered limma on VST reports 1.

coverage.note: Selected FDR<0.1 genes only; the author nonsignificant tail is not available.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Direction route evaluated on 97 nonzero pairs covering 0.9604 of the selected reference; correlation reported, not gating. A significant-only list cannot establish full-universe agreement. Require confirmation of the author Diet estimand and orientation before any effect match. No full-result acceptance is established.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Selected author effects mostly agree in direction (96/97); contrast estimand, effect definition, inference and coverage remain qualified.
